canonical_project: Retelit Avalon Campus (Milan) + Corsico new build
owner: Retelit S.p.A. (Avalon 1/2/3 Milan, Avalon 5 Settimo Milanese; Corsico under construction)
notes: Avalon Campus = largest neutral colocation ecosystem in Italy: Avalon 1 (Caldera, Milan), Avalon 2, Avalon 3 (Via Bisceglie 95, Milan) interconnected by fiber, 13,000 sqm / 2,600+ racks; Avalon 5 (Settimo Milanese, Tier IV AI-ready) acquired 2025 with BT Italia assets.
